description: Qualification equivalence edges (CLAUDE.md section 7, step 4). A match through any edge gives AUDIT ('carry the equivalence order'), never PROBABLE_MATCH. The solver follows edges from the candidate's qualification towards the required one, same discipline only, at most 3 hops, no cycles. Tags match the qualification tags used in notices. A required tag without a discipline is met by that tag with any discipline (for example M.Com in Finance meets 'M.Com'); that is a direct match, not an edge.
